elaine: quick question about /v1/embeddings behavior when clients send mixed inputs (empty string, null, and long text) in the same batch — what's our current contract?

noah: we should define it explicitly. currently the runtime will accept nulls but they'll get coerced to "" before encoding, AFAIK. empty string returns a vector (usually non-zero).

rahul: to be precise: on the server side we call normalize_inputs -> map null to "" -> tokenization. no hard error unless payload is malformed JSON.

jessica: customer asked if we drop empty items to keep index alignment. important: many downstream consumers expect 1:1 ordering preserved.

elaine: yeah that's my worry. dropping items breaks alignment. we should either always return an entry for each input (even if it's a zero vector) or guarantee an index mapping in the response.

noah: agreed. proposal: keep 1:1 output ordering. For empty string and null return an embedding as usual (call it out in docs). If we ever change to drop items, must introduce a response-id map for backward compat.

rahul: note on truncation: we currently truncate at token length 8192 by default for most models. behaviour is to truncate from the end. should we expose truncation policy param (truncate: front|back|error)?

jessica: exposing param is nice but could be confusing. maybe add behavioral flag in model profile + optional query param for advanced clients. default stays back-truncate.

elaine: quick dev check: does the runtime return a consistent vector length for empty input? written test failing for T-quantized models returns all zeros for "" sometimes.

rahul: that's a bug. quantized kernels may produce different NaN/zero behavior on degenerate input. I'll add a unit test to force deterministic output for "" and null.

noah: batching edge: if client sends a batch with size > max_batch (2048 items) we currently 413 with message: "batch size exceeded". Should we split batches server-side automatically?

jessica: splitting server-side can hide billing/latency behaviour and makes rate limiting weird. prefer require client to split and return 413. Add clear error msg that includes recommended chunk size.

elaine: summary action items:
- rahul: add deterministic empty/null test for quantized kernels (ticket: ENG-1234)
- noah: update docs block for embeddings contract: 1:1 ordering guaranteed, null->"" coerced, empty returns embedding, truncation default back-truncate (ticket: DOCS-987)
- jessica: update error text for batch-too-large to include recommended chunk size (ticket: UX-432)

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy queued: embeddings-runtime patch v1.2.3 -> staging at 2026-07-12T03:00:00Z :rocket:

elaine: thanks all — ping me if you disagree with the default behaviors. I'll update the API contract doc and link it here once done.
